facts.fact: Adam、Argent 与 Silver 赶往西望塔时，女妖已横扫墓地、屠杀失落者，随后才转向那座方正的塔楼建筑。
facts.anchor: It appeared the banshees had swept through the graveyard, slaughtering the Lost before turning to the blocky building.

facts.fact: Carl 倒下了——他耳中塞着两团厚蜡（two thick plugs of wax）战斗到最后一刻；Eran 为他探颈动脉后摇头。
facts.anchor: He lay broken, his bandaged nose the least of his issues. He’d gone down fighting, two thick plugs of wax in his ears.

facts.fact: Adam 去看 Lily 是否还在纸板教堂，教堂已空；外面的一座新坟说明了一切。
facts.anchor: A fresh grave outside told him all he needed to know.

facts.fact: 重伤濒死的 Seamus 开价索要 Binder（即 Adam 本人）作为获救交换，Silver 拒绝“削弱我的宫廷去强化你的宫廷”。
facts.anchor: “I’m not weakening my court to strengthen yours,” Silver said.

facts.fact: Adam 提出两个宫廷之间的“交换计划”（让 Seamus 辖区没有前途的年轻 fay 去 RCC 或在 Silver 宫廷任职），Silver 表示可以接受，但眼神示意此事还没完。
facts.anchor: “I would be amenable to that,” Silver said, though his eyes told Adam they’d be speaking about this later.

facts.fact: 北塔的防御未被女妖攻破，但那里的失落者损失极其惨重（beyond decimated）。
facts.anchor: The northern tower had fared better. The banshees had not broached its defenses, though the Lost Ones were beyond decimated.

facts.fact: Silver 当庭追问剑之骑士（Knight of Swords）的下落，Eran 回答他们不知道、无人能找到她。
facts.anchor: “We do not know, sire,” Eran answered. “None can find her.”

facts.fact: Silver 私下透露：他虽不知 North 出生的细节，却已知晓这个男孩近五十年（nearly fifty years），并指出 North 是半人类、早已成年。
facts.anchor: “I am not privy to the specifics of his birth, but I’ve known of North for nearly fifty years.”
